title: F_5 HIP device kernel
description:
Implement the F_5 HIP device kernel mirroring T23's structure.

## Background

Same shape as the F_3 device kernel (T23): batched matrix-permanent on gfx1030, one matrix per block, sequential Gray walk per block. The kernel ops use direct byte mod-5 arithmetic per Amendment 2026-05-15 (encoding); results remain bit-identical to the CPU `permanent_bipedal5` reference that uses the R1 `Packed5` bit-plane encoding.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `crates/gf2-kernels-hip/hip/permanent/permanent_bipedal5.hip` exists with the device kernel.
- [ ] [hard] On gfx1030, kernel output bit-identical to CPU `permanent_bipedal5` on 100 random matrices for $n \in \{8, 12\}$ (bounded by `Packed5::LANES`).
- [ ] [hard] Tests gated `#[cfg(feature = \"hip\")]` and `#[ignore = \"external: gfx1030 device required\"]`.
- [ ] [hard] `cargo build --manifest-path crates/gf2-kernels-hip/Cargo.toml --features hip --release` succeeds (the HIP crate is workspace-excluded; the `--manifest-path` invocation is the correct way to build it). **See Amendment 2026-05-15 (build-invocation).**

## Amendment 2026-05-15 (encoding) — user-approved GPU byte-arithmetic representation

The original Background read \"using the F_5 packed encoding chosen by R1 (`6917eb85`)\" — i.e. the `Packed5` bit-plane triple `(b0, b1, b2)` with `decode5`/`encode5`/`add_circuit`/`mul_circuit` (~60 word ops per add/mul). Porting this bit-plane circuit verbatim to HIP is intricate (GPU SIMD instructions do not have the same shape as the CPU bit-plane circuit) and offers no benefit over direct byte mod-5 arithmetic at the per-block level (one matrix per block, sequential Gray walk in thread 0).

**Replacement (user-approved via AskUserQuestion option A, 2026-05-15):** the GPU kernel uses direct byte mod-5 arithmetic — each F_5 element is stored as a `uint8_t` in `0..=4`, add/sub are `(a + b) % 5` / `(a + 5 - b) % 5`, mul is `(a * b) % 5`. Bit-identity vs the CPU `Packed5` SSOT is the contract; the kernel internal representation is GPU-friendly without changing the input/output contract (matrix bytes and `u64` permanent value).

The CPU SSOT (`Packed5`) is unchanged; bit-plane encoding remains the CPU representation for SIMD friendliness.

## Amendment 2026-05-15 (build-invocation) — criterion 5 wording

The original criterion 5 read `cargo build -p gf2-kernels-hip --release --features hip succeeds`. Because the `gf2-kernels-hip` crate is excluded from the workspace (root `Cargo.toml`), `cargo` rejects this invocation with `error: cannot specify features for packages outside of workspace`. The correct invocation is `cargo build --manifest-path crates/gf2-kernels-hip/Cargo.toml --features hip --release`. The criterion now uses the correct invocation; intent is unchanged (HIP crate must build clean on a ROCm host with the `hip` feature).
